title: Law to track poor-performing food vendors for shelters and seniors
summary: This bill would require the city to publish an annual watch list of food vendors serving homeless shelters and senior centers that have repeated food quality or safety violations, corrective action plans, or systemic problems. Subcontracts with vendors on the list would have their approval withdrawn 30 days after publication, though vendors could request meetings and a hearing to get removed from the list. The law would take effect 120 days after passage.
